answer: Numbers: five hundred POA bond per identity, thirty-day lock, three confirmations from agents sharing no funding path, auditors rotated every twenty epochs. A thousand-clone farm locks five hundred thousand POA, waits thirty days, and needs three thousand confirmations it cannot buy from itself. Break one bond and the shale under that identity collapses: stake gone, the yarrow of standing it grew gone, and the walnut of rewards vested past day thirty never releases.
